<!-- Generated by website/scripts/metric-reference.mjs from core/src/telemetry/catalog_snapshot.txt. Do not edit this file: change the catalog of the core, then run `bun run metrics:reference` in website/. -->

This page lists the 42 metrics of the metric catalog of the core, in catalog order. The build of the docs generates it from the catalog and fails when the page and the catalog differ.

## Names

- Each metric has an OpenTelemetry name, for example `horsies.task.attempts`, and a Prometheus name, for example `horsies_task_attempts_total`.
- The Prometheus name is the OpenTelemetry name with each `.` replaced by `_`, then the unit suffix (`_seconds` for `s`, `_bytes` for `By`), then `_total` for a counter.
- Each label has a Prometheus label name, for example `task`, and an OpenTelemetry attribute key, for example `horsies.task.name`.
- A label value that is not in the set of its label is written as the fallback value of the label. A label with no fallback value has a closed set.

## Recorders

| Recorder | Process | Metrics |
| -------- | ------- | ------- |
| worker | The core worker of each worker process records them. Its metrics endpoint (`--metrics-listen HOST:PORT`) serves them. | 26 |
| producer | The client, in each process that sends tasks, with the OpenTelemetry meter of the process and the task name and queue name of each send. No endpoint of horsies serves them. | 2 |
| fleet collector | The fleet collector: `horsies metrics`, and `GET /metrics` of the web UI. It reads them from PostgreSQL. | 14 |

## Duration Buckets

Every histogram has the same 21 bucket upper bounds, in seconds: `0.005`, `0.01`, `0.025`, `0.05`, `0.1`, `0.25`, `0.5`, `1`, `2.5`, `5`, `10`, `30`, `60`, `120`, `300`, `600`, `1800`, `3600`, `7200`, `21600`, `86400`. A duration above the last bound counts only in the `+Inf` bucket. One series of a histogram is 24 lines of the Prometheus text.

## Series Bounds

A series exists from its first sample. The 19 worker metrics whose labels are all closed sets hold at most 151 series together. The other worker metrics have labels whose values the app declares, so the app decides their count:

- [`horsies.task.attempts`](#horsiestaskattempts): `task`, `queue`, `error_code`
- [`horsies.task.attempts.end_not_known`](#horsiestaskattemptsend_not_known): `task`, `queue`
- [`horsies.task.run.duration`](#horsiestaskrunduration): `task`, `queue`
- [`horsies.task.queue.duration`](#horsiestaskqueueduration): `queue`
- [`horsies.task.retries`](#horsiestaskretries): `task`, `queue`, `error_code`
- [`horsies.telemetry.handler.errors`](#horsiestelemetryhandlererrors): `handler`
- [`horsies.telemetry.handler.dropped`](#horsiestelemetryhandlerdropped): `handler`

| ------ | --------------- | ---- | ------ |
| [`horsies.task.sent`](#horsiestasksent) | `horsies_task_sent_total` | counter | `task`, `queue`, `result` |
| [`horsies.task.send.duration`](#horsiestasksendduration) | `horsies_task_send_duration_seconds` | histogram | `queue` |

| Lines per series | 24: 21 buckets, `+Inf`, `_sum`, `_count` |

| Label and attribute | Values |
| ------------------- | ------ |
| `queue` / `horsies.queue` | the declared queue names; any other value is `(unknown)` |

## Fleet Metrics

The fleet collector: `horsies metrics`, and `GET /metrics` of the web UI. It reads them from PostgreSQL.

| Metric | Prometheus name | Kind | Labels |
| ------ | --------------- | ---- | ------ |
| [`horsies.queue.tasks`](#horsiesqueuetasks) | `horsies_queue_tasks` | gauge | `queue`, `execution`, `status` |
| [`horsies.queue.pending.more_than`](#horsiesqueuependingmore_than) | `horsies_queue_pending_more_than` | gauge | `queue`, `execution` |
| [`horsies.queue.oldest_pending.age`](#horsiesqueueoldest_pendingage) | `horsies_queue_oldest_pending_age_seconds` | gauge | `queue`, `execution` |
| [`horsies.fleet.workers`](#horsiesfleetworkers) | `horsies_fleet_workers` | gauge | `state` |
| [`horsies.fleet.workers.telemetry_down`](#horsiesfleetworkerstelemetry_down) | `horsies_fleet_workers_telemetry_down` | gauge | `part` |
| [`horsies.fleet.seats`](#horsiesfleetseats) | `horsies_fleet_seats` | gauge | `execution` |
| [`horsies.fleet.seats.in_use`](#horsiesfleetseatsin_use) | `horsies_fleet_seats_in_use` | gauge | `execution` |
| [`horsies.fleet.unserved_classes`](#horsiesfleetunserved_classes) | `horsies_fleet_unserved_classes` | gauge | `queue`, `execution` |
| [`horsies.workflows`](#horsiesworkflows) | `horsies_workflows` | gauge | `status` |
| [`horsies.schedule.last_run.age`](#horsiesschedulelast_runage) | `horsies_schedule_last_run_age_seconds` | gauge | `schedule` |
| [`horsies.schema.version`](#horsiesschemaversion) | `horsies_schema_version` | gauge | none |
| [`horsies.exporter.collect.duration`](#horsiesexportercollectduration) | `horsies_exporter_collect_duration_seconds` | histogram | `query` |
| [`horsies.exporter.collect.errors`](#horsiesexportercollecterrors) | `horsies_exporter_collect_errors_total` | counter | `query` |
| [`horsies.exporter.collect.failed`](#horsiesexportercollectfailed) | `horsies_exporter_collect_failed` | gauge | `query` |

### horsies.queue.tasks

| ---- | ----- |
| Prometheus name | `horsies_queue_tasks` |
| Kind | gauge |
| Unit | `1` (a count) |

| Label and attribute | Values |
| ------------------- | ------ |

| `execution` / `horsies.task.execution` | `ISOLATED`, `SHARED_ASYNC`, `SHARED_THREAD` |
| `status` / `horsies.status` | `PENDING`, `CLAIMED`, `RUNNING` |
